literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 更昔洛韦和阿昔洛韦显示出与 RSV 核蛋白的显着结合能和关键相互作用,ADMET 和 PASS 分析显示出作为 抗病毒药物 核蛋白药物的潜力。 [10.1002/bab.70193]
佐剂 RSVPreF3 的安全性与临床试验中观察到的一致,显示出未改变且有利的获益-风险特征。大多数不良事件是非严重的反应原事件,观察到的吉兰-巴利综合征和心房颤动的发生率并不表明与背景 发病率 相比风险过高。 [10.1007/s40264-026-01698-y]
在第三次EQA中,73个实验室(90.1%)返回结果,其中69.9%为良好,15.1%为可接受,1.4%为满意(86.3%为理想),12.3%为不可接受,1.4%为差;在第四次EQA中,74个实验室(87.1%)返回结果,其中60.8%为良好,28.4%为可接受,2.7%为满意(91.9%为理想),8.1%为不可接受。 [10.1111/irv.70302]
与未感染 RSV-A Gdup+ 的儿童相比,RSV-A Gdup+ 感染的儿童 5 年当前哮喘的调整后比值比为 2.00 (95%CI = 1.15-3.47),而 RSV-B Gdup+ 感染的调整后比值比为 1.78 (95%CI = 1.01-3.11)。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag104]
校正后的分析显示,疫苗 对产后 180 天内全因医疗下呼吸道疾病的疗效为 4.1%(95% CI,-9.5 至 16.0)。 [10.1097/aog.0000000000006358]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Ganciclovir and acyclovir revealed notable binding energy and critical interactions with RSV nucleoprotein, with ADMET and PASS analysis showing potential as antiviral drugs against nucleoprotein. [10.1002/bab.70193]
The safety profile of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 is consistent with that observed in clinical trials, showing an unchanged and favorable benefit-risk profile. [10.1007/s40264-026-01698-y]

In the third EQA, 73 laboratories (90.1%) returned results, with 69.9% classified as good, 15.1% acceptable, and 1.4% satisfactory (86.3% desirable), while 12.3% were unacceptable and 1.4% poor; in the fourth EQA, 74 laboratories (87.1%) returned results, with 60.8% good, 28.4% acceptable, and 2.7% satisfactory (91.9% desirable), and 8.1% unacceptable. [10.1111/irv.70302]

Children with RSV-A Gdup+ infections had an adjusted odds ratio of 2.00 (95%CI = 1.15-3.47) for 5-year current asthma compared to those without RSV infection, while RSV-B Gdup+ infections had an adjusted odds ratio of 1.78 (95%CI = 1.01-3.11). [10.1093/infdis/jiag104]

The corrected analysis showed vaccine efficacy of 4.1% (95% CI, −9.5 to 16.0) against all-cause medically attended lower respiratory tract illness within 180 days postpartum. [10.1097/aog.0000000000006358]

news.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 关于 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 的一般信息,呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是一种传染性病原体,会导致易感人群出现轻度感冒样疾病,但会导致严重的下呼吸道疾病。没有报告 暴发 或事件。 [news-b1c77daf01cc515e]
呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是五岁以下儿童急性下呼吸道感染的主要原因,对全世界儿童健康构成持续威胁。婴儿早期感染 RSV 会显着增加患儿童哮喘的风险,尤其是有过敏或哮喘家族史的儿童。RSV 还会导致老年人出现严重后果和心脏并发症。 [news-bedfbee549edd3cf]
辉瑞全球医疗补助金 (GMG) 与母胎医学协会 (SMFM) 合作发起的质量改进补助金机会,旨在改善孕产妇妊娠期间 RSV 免疫接种。 [news-7750abd7e0d25b7f]
根据 JCVI 的建议,已确认扩大 NHS RSV 疫苗接种 计划,将 65-74 岁的成年人纳入临床高危人群。 [news-a241a3f751031b21]
一项横断面调查研究发现,超过一半的孕妇 (58.2%) 和近一半的父母 (48.3%) 更喜欢母体 RSV 疫苗接种,而不是给幼儿注射单克隆抗体。该研究由公共卫生硕士 Rachael Porter 及其同事在埃默里大学罗林斯公共卫生学院进行。 [news-83761480970671fb]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Respiratory syncytial virus news developments.
key_findings_en: General information about respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), an infectious agent causing mild coldlike illness but severe lower respiratory disease in susceptible individuals. No outbreak or event is reported. [news-b1c77daf01cc515e]
Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections in children under five and poses a persistent threat to child health worldwide. [news-bedfbee549edd3cf]

A Quality Improvement Grant opportunity launched by Pfizer Global Medical Grants (GMG) in collaboration with the Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine (SMFM) to improve maternal RSV immunization delivery during pregnancy. [news-7750abd7e0d25b7f]
Confirmed expansion of NHS RSV vaccination programme to include adults aged 65-74 in clinical at-risk groups, advised by JCVI. [news-a241a3f751031b21]

A cross-sectional survey study found that more than half of pregnant women (58.2%) and nearly half of parents (48.3%) preferred maternal RSV vaccination over monoclonal antibody injections for young children. [news-83761480970671fb]

papers.title: AS01 E -Adjuvanted Respiratory Syncytial Virus Prefusion F Protein Vaccine (Adjuvanted RSVPreF3): Review of the First 2 Years of Post-Marketing Safety Surveillance.
papers.abstract: The AS01E-adjuvanted respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F protein vaccine (adjuvanted RSVPreF3) received its first marketing authorization in May 2023 for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus lower respiratory tract disease in individuals aged ≥ 60 years. We conducted a review of post-marketing safety surveillance data following adjuvanted RSVPreF3 administration. Spontaneous adverse events (AEs) that were reported worldwide since the first approval (3 May, 2023) to 2 May, 2025 in the GSK global safety database were analyzed. Up to 2 May, 2025, 13.4 million doses of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 were distributed globally. A total of 2861 spontaneous reports, including 7012 AEs (serious: 11.0%), were received. The most frequent AEs consisted mainly of non-serious reactogenic events. Of all reports, 1164 described vaccination errors, with most frequent errors consisting of either wrong product administration (N = 243) or administration to patients of an inappropriate age (N = 204). The majority (90.3%) of vaccination error reports were not associated with any other AEs. Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 was erroneously administered to pregnant individuals in 415 cases; most reports (95.2%) occurred without associated AEs. Observed-to-expected analysis of reports of Guillain–Barré syndrome (N = 37) did not suggest an increased risk compared to background incidence of this event and the reports of atrial fibrillation (N = 29) did not indicate an excess risk. Review of the post-marketing surveillance data from 2 years of exposure to adjuvanted RSVPreF3 showed that the safety profile of the vaccine is consistent with that observed in clinical trials supporting an unchanged and favorable benefit-risk profile for the vaccine. Additional post-marketing surveillance is ongoing to further evaluate a potential risk of rare AEs, such as Guillain–Barré syndrome, following adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination. Respiratory syncytial virus is an important cause of severe lung infections in older adults. Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccine was first approved in 2023 to prevent respiratory syncytial virus disease in adults aged 60 years and older. Regularly analyzing safety information from ongoing studies and real-world data (from routine healthcare practice) is essential to identify any potential new risks linked to adjuvanted RSVPreF3. Using the manufacturer’s (GSK) safety database, we analyzed the real-world safety data from individuals who experienced adverse events after vaccination with adjuvanted RSVPreF3. These data were collected during the first 2 years since the vaccine’s initial approval. The majority of adverse events reported to the manufacturer were mild and consistent with those reported in clinical trials. Most individuals who received the vaccine by mistake did not experience adverse events. The proportion of individuals who experienced Guillain–Barré syndrome after vaccination was within the range of background incidence rates of this disease in older adults. The reports of atrial fibrillation reflected the natural history of the disease for the older population. The safety data, collected over 2 years of substantial exposure to adjuvanted RSVPreF3, show that the safety profile of this vaccine is similar to that seen in clinical trials. Together with pre-licensure data demonstrating the vaccine’s ability to protect and help the immune system against respiratory syncytial virus disease, and real-world data demonstrating that adjuvanted RSVPreF3 protects against respiratory syncytial virus-associated hospitalization, the safety information collected so far supports the vaccine’s use for the people for whom it is authorized.

A total of 13.4 million doses were distributed globally, and 2861 spontaneous reports, including 7012 adverse events (11.0% serious), were received.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The safety profile of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 is consistent with that observed in clinical trials, showing an unchanged and favorable benefit-risk profile. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: While the majority of vaccination errors (e.g., wrong product administration or inappropriate age) were not associated with adverse events, there is ongoing surveillance to evaluate potential rare adverse events like Guillain–Barré syndrome. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Continued post-marketing surveillance is essential to monitor rare adverse events and further assess the vaccine's long-term safety. The real-world data support the vaccine's use for authorized populations, but ongoing analysis of safety information from routine healthcare practice is recommended to identify any potential new risks.

analysis.summary_en: This review summarizes the first 2 years of post-marketing safety surveillance for the AS01E-adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccine, approved for adults aged ≥ 60 years. Based on 13.4 million distributed doses and 2861 spontaneous reports, the vaccine's safety profile aligns with clinical trial data, with most adverse events being mild and reactogenic. No excess risk was observed for Guillain–Barré syndrome or atrial fibrillation. Vaccination errors, including administration to inappropriate age groups or pregnant individuals, were mostly uneventful. Ongoing surveillance is recommended to monitor rare adverse events and maintain the vaccine's favorable benefit-risk profile.

elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review analyzed spontaneous adverse events reported worldwide from the first marketing authorization (3 May 2023) to 2 May 2025, using the GSK global safety database. A total of 13.4 million doses were distributed globally, and 2861 spontaneous reports, including 7012 adverse events (11.0% serious), were received.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The safety profile of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 is consistent with that observed in clinical trials, showing an unchanged and favorable benefit-risk profile. Most adverse events were non-serious reactogenic events, and observed rates of Guillain–Barré syndrome and atrial fibrillation did not indicate excess risk compared to background incidence.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: While the majority of vaccination errors (e.g., wrong product administration or inappropriate age) were not associated with adverse events, there is ongoing surveillance to evaluate potential rare adverse events like Guillain–Barré syndrome. The data reflect real-world use but may not capture all rare events due to spontaneous reporting limitations.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Continued post-marketing surveillance is essential to monitor rare adverse events and further assess the vaccine's long-term safety. The real-world data support the vaccine's use for authorized populations, but ongoing analysis of safety information from routine healthcare practice is recommended to identify any potential new risks.

papers.title_zh: AS01 E -佐剂 呼吸道合胞病毒 预融合 F 蛋白 疫苗(佐剂 RSVPreF3):上市后前 2 年安全性回顾 监测。
papers.source_body_en: The AS01E-adjuvanted respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F protein vaccine (adjuvanted RSVPreF3) received its first marketing authorization in May 2023 for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus lower respiratory tract disease in individuals aged ≥ 60 years. We conducted a review of post-marketing safety surveillance data following adjuvanted RSVPreF3 administration. Spontaneous adverse events (AEs) that were reported worldwide since the first approval (3 May, 2023) to 2 May, 2025 in the GSK global safety database were analyzed. Up to 2 May, 2025, 13.4 million doses of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 were distributed globally. A total of 2861 spontaneous reports, including 7012 AEs (serious: 11.0%), were received. The most frequent AEs consisted mainly of non-serious reactogenic events. Of all reports, 1164 described vaccination errors, with most frequent errors consisting of either wrong product administration (N = 243) or administration to patients of an inappropriate age (N = 204). The majority (90.3%) of vaccination error reports were not associated with any other AEs. Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 was erroneously administered to pregnant individuals in 415 cases; most reports (95.2%) occurred without associated AEs. Observed-to-expected analysis of reports of Guillain–Barré syndrome (N = 37) did not suggest an increased risk compared to background incidence of this event and the reports of atrial fibrillation (N = 29) did not indicate an excess risk. Review of the post-marketing surveillance data from 2 years of exposure to adjuvanted RSVPreF3 showed that the safety profile of the vaccine is consistent with that observed in clinical trials supporting an unchanged and favorable benefit-risk profile for the vaccine. Additional post-marketing surveillance is ongoing to further evaluate a potential risk of rare AEs, such as Guillain–Barré syndrome, following adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination. Respiratory syncytial virus is an important cause of severe lung infections in older adults. Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccine was first approved in 2023 to prevent respiratory syncytial virus disease in adults aged 60 years and older. Regularly analyzing safety information from ongoing studies and real-world data (from routine healthcare practice) is essential to identify any potential new risks linked to adjuvanted RSVPreF3. Using the manufacturer’s (GSK) safety database, we analyzed the real-world safety data from individuals who experienced adverse events after vaccination with adjuvanted RSVPreF3. These data were collected during the first 2 years since the vaccine’s initial approval. The majority of adverse events reported to the manufacturer were mild and consistent with those reported in clinical trials. Most individuals who received the vaccine by mistake did not experience adverse events. The proportion of individuals who experienced Guillain–Barré syndrome after vaccination was within the range of background incidence rates of this disease in older adults. The reports of atrial fibrillation reflected the natural history of the disease for the older population. The safety data, collected over 2 years of substantial exposure to adjuvanted RSVPreF3, show that the safety profile of this vaccine is similar to that seen in clinical trials. Together with pre-licensure data demonstrating the vaccine’s ability to protect and help the immune system against respiratory syncytial virus disease, and real-world data demonstrating that adjuvanted RSVPreF3 protects against respiratory syncytial virus-associated hospitalization, the safety information collected so far supports the vaccine’s use for the people for whom it is authorized.

papers.title: Results From the Third and Fourth WHO External Quality Assessments for the Molecular Detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background In 2016, the World Health Organization (WHO) initiated the global RSV surveillance programme, which aimed to strengthen laboratory diagnostic capacity and evaluate molecular detection test performance. External quality assessments (EQAs) are conducted regularly as part of this programme to ensure ongoing laboratory proficiency. The third (2021–2022) and the fourth (2023–2024) WHO RSV EQAs were conducted to evaluate the ability of participating laboratories to accurately detect and subtype RSV. Methods For each EQA panel, 12 lyophilised RSV isolates were prepared using both recently circulating and RSV strains used in previous EQAs. The isolates were shipped to 81 and 85 laboratories in the third and fourth EQA, respectively. Participants tested the specimens using their routine molecular diagnostic protocols and reported the results through the UK NEQAS online platform. Performance was evaluated based on detection and subtyping accuracy, and a scoring system was used that ranged from good performance (24/24 correct results) to unacceptable (≤ 16 correct results). Results A total of 73 (90.1%) and 74 (87.1%) laboratories returned results for the third and fourth RSV molecular EQAs, respectively. In the third EQA, 69.9% of laboratories were classified as good, 15.1% as acceptable and 1.4% as satisfactory, resulting in 86.3% within the desirable range; 12.3% were unacceptable and 1.4% poor. In the fourth EQA, 60.8% were good, 28.4% acceptable and 2.7% satisfactory, with 91.9% in the desirable range; 8.1% were unacceptable, and none were poor. Conclusion The third and fourth WHO RSV EQA demonstrated good overall laboratory performance for RSV molecular detection and subtyping. These findings highlight the importance of EQA to document high‐quality diagnostics, especially with the introduction of RSV vaccines and monoclonal antibodies. Ongoing EQAs, including the first WHO RSV sequencing EQA initiated in 2024, will further enhance global laboratory capacity for RSV surveillance and outbreak response.

papers.title: Repurposing FDA-Approved Antiviral Drugs Ganciclovir and Acyclovir Against Respiratory Syncytial Virus Nucleoprotein: Molecular Docking, ADMET, PASS, and Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a prevalent viral respiratory infection that has been increasingly affecting children under 5 years old globally. Although RSV can infect individuals of all ages, certain groups are at higher risk, particularly infants and young children. This growing concern underscores the urgent need for effective therapeutic options. In this context, drug repurposing emerges as a promising strategy, allowing existing medications to be utilized for new therapeutic applications beyond their original indications. In this research, we utilized library of FDA‐approved antiviral drugs that show potential for repurposing. We performed molecular docking against RSV nucleoprotein. The two resulting drugs, ganciclovir and acyclovir, reveal notable binding energy and critical interactions. Further ADMET profile and prediction of activity spectra for substances (PASS) analysis show potential to be antiviral drugs against nucleoprotein. Furthermore, molecular dynamics simulations for 500 ns were conducted, along with calculations of principal component analysis (PCA) and Gibbs free energy for the most promising ligand–receptor complexes identified in docking ADMET and PASS analysis (ganciclovir and acyclovir). The simulations provided insights into their thermodynamic and dynamic properties, further investigating the docking results. The findings from this study offer valuable leads for the development of therapeutic agents against RSV. However, to substantiate the preventive and therapeutic potential of these compounds, further validations, including in vitro, animal studies, and rigorous clinical trials, are necessary.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是一种流行的病毒性呼吸道感染,对全球 5 岁以下儿童的影响越来越大。尽管 RSV 可以感染所有年龄段的个体,但某些群体的风险较高,尤其是婴儿和幼儿。这种日益增长的担忧凸显了对有效治疗方案的迫切需要。在这种背景下,药物再利用成为一种有前途的策略,使现有药物能够用于超出其原始适应症的新治疗应用。在这项研究中,我们利用了 FDA 批准的 抗病毒药物 药物库,这些药物显示出重新利用的潜力。我们对 RSV 核蛋白进行了分子对接。由此产生的两种药物,更昔洛韦和阿昔洛韦,显示出显着的结合能和关键的相互作用。进一步的 ADMET 概况和物质活性谱预测 (PASS) 分析表明 抗病毒药物 药物具有抗核蛋白的潜力。此外,还进行了 500 ns 的分子动力学模拟,并计算了对接 ADMET 和 PASS 分析(更昔洛韦和阿昔洛韦)中确定的最有前途的配体-受体复合物的主成分分析 (PCA) 和吉布斯自由能。模拟提供了对其热力学和动力学特性的深入了解,进一步研究了对接结果。这项研究的结果为开发 RSV 治疗药物提供了宝贵的线索。然而,为了证实这些化合物的预防和治疗潜力,需要进一步验证,包括体外、动物研究和严格的临床试验。

papers.title: Cost-effectiveness of RSVpreF for the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus illness among high-risk adults in Germany.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Vaccination against lower respiratory tract illness due to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV-LRTI) is approved in Europe for all adults aged ≥18 years. The German Standing Committee on Vaccination (STIKO), however, only recommends vaccination for high-risk adults aged 60-74 years and all adults aged ≥75 years (standard of care [SOC]). Younger, immunocompromised adults [IC], as well as those with chronic medical conditions [CMC+], remain unprotected. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A multi-cohort model projected lifetime RSV-related clinical and economic outcomes (in 2025 €) among adults in Germany. Base case analyses considered the cost-effectiveness of adding vaccination of IC adults aged 18-59 years to the SOC from a societal perspective. An expanded base case adding CMC+/IC adults aged 18-59 years to the SOC was also evaluated. RESULTS: Adding IC adults aged 18-59 years to the recommendation would prevent 6,490 additional cases, avert 199 more deaths, and reduce costs by 21 million € compared to the SOC. Incorporating CMC+/IC adults would prevent 24,545 additional cases and 388 deaths, at an incremental cost of 238 million €. CONCLUSIONS: Expanding the recommendation to include IC or CMC+/IC adults aged 18-59 years could substantially reduce the clinical burden of RSV-LRTI in Germany; including IC 18-59-year-olds would also be cost-saving.

The German Standing Committee on Vaccination (STIKO), however, only recommends vaccination for high-risk adults aged 60-74 years and all adults aged ≥75 years (standard of care [SOC]). Younger, immunocompromised adults [IC], as well as those with chronic medical conditions [CMC+], remain unprotected. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A multi-cohort model projected lifetime RSV-related clinical and economic outcomes (in 2025 €) among adults in Germany. Base case analyses considered the cost-effectiveness of adding vaccination of IC adults aged 18-59 years to the SOC from a societal perspective. An expanded base case adding CMC+/IC adults aged 18-59 years to the SOC was also evaluated. RESULTS: Adding IC adults aged 18-59 years to the recommendation would prevent 6,490 additional cases, avert 199 more deaths, and reduce costs by 21 million € compared to the SOC. Incorporating CMC+/IC adults would prevent 24,545 additional cases and 388 deaths, at an incremental cost of 238 million €. CONCLUSIONS: Expanding the recommendation to include IC or CMC+/IC adults aged 18-59 years could substantially reduce the clinical burden of RSV-LRTI in Germany; including IC 18-59-year-olds would also be cost-saving.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of expanding RSV vaccination recommendations to include younger, immunocompromised adults in Germany, given that current guidelines only cover high-risk adults aged 60-74 years and all adults aged ≥75 years.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A multi-cohort model projected lifetime RSV-related clinical and economic outcomes among adults in Germany, focusing on immunocompromised adults aged 18-59 years and those with chronic medical conditions.
analysis.methods: The analysis used a multi-cohort model to project lifetime RSV-related clinical and economic outcomes in 2025 €, evaluating cost-effectiveness from a societal perspective with base cases for immunocompromised adults and an expanded group including those with chronic medical conditions.
analysis.main_results: Adding immunocompromised adults aged 18-59 years to the standard of care would prevent 6,490 additional cases, avert 199 more deaths, and reduce costs by 21 million €; incorporating chronic medical condition patients would prevent 24,545 additional cases and 388 deaths at an incremental cost of 238 million €.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that expanding vaccination recommendations to include immunocompromised or chronic medical condition adults aged 18-59 years could substantially reduce the clinical burden of RSV-LRTI, with the immunocompromised group also being cost-saving.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that expanding RSV vaccination to younger high-risk adults could significantly reduce disease burden and mortality, with potential cost savings for immunocompromised individuals, informing policy decisions in Germany.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on a model-based projection rather than real-world data, which may introduce uncertainty in predicting long-term outcomes and cost-effectiveness.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness of expanding RSV vaccination recommendations to include younger, immunocompromised adults in Germany. Using a multi-cohort model, the researchers projected that adding immunocompromised adults aged 18-59 years to the standard of care would prevent 6,490 additional cases, avert 199 deaths, and reduce costs by 21 million €. Expanding to include those with chronic medical conditions would prevent 24,545 cases and 388 deaths but at an incremental cost of 238 million €. The authors concluded that such expansions could substantially reduce RSV-LRTI burden, with the immunocompromised group being cost-saving. The findings provide evidence-based support for updating vaccination policies to better protect high-risk younger adults.

elements_zh.methods: 该分析使用多 队列研究 模型来预测 2025 年与 RSV 相关的终生临床和经济结果,从社会角度评估成本效益,并以免疫功能低下成年人和包括慢性病患者在内的扩大群体为基础案例。
elements_zh.main_results: Adding immunocompromised adults aged 18-59 years to the standard of care would prevent 6,490 additional cases, avert 199 more deaths, and reduce costs by 21 million €; incorporating chronic medical condition patients would prevent 24,545 additional cases and 388 deaths at an incremental cost of 238 million €.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,将 疫苗接种 建议扩大到包括 18-59 岁免疫功能低下或患有慢性疾病的成年人,可以大大减轻 RSV-LRTI 的临床负担,同时免疫功能低下人群也可以节省成本。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将 RSV 疫苗接种 扩大到年轻的高危成年人可以显着减轻疾病负担和 死亡率,为免疫功能低下的个体节省成本,为德国的政策决策提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于基于模型的预测而不是现实世界的数据,这可能会给预测长期结果和成本效益带来不确定性。

papers.title: Parents’ awareness of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and its prevention: a cross-sectional study in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Abstract Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) represents a major public health challenge as a primary cause of lower respiratory tract infections in infants and young children globally, with an estimated 33 million cases and 100,000 deaths annually in children under five. Despite recent advances in RSV immunoprophylaxis, parental understanding of RSV epidemiology, transmission dynamics, vulnerable populations, and available preventive strategies remains inadequately characterized in Middle Eastern populations. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and determinants of parental awareness regarding RSV and its prevention among parents in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We conducted a community-based cross-sectional survey among parents residing in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, between February and March 2026. Using convenience sampling through online platforms, we recruited parents with at least one child. A structured, self-administered Arabic questionnaire assessed demographic characteristics, prior RSV awareness, knowledge of transmission routes and clinical manifestations, recognition of high-risk groups, and awareness of preventive immunization. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests to examine associations between demographic variables and RSV awareness. Among 214 eligible parents, the majority were female and held bachelor’s degrees. Only 35.0% (95% CI: 28.7–41.8%) had previously heard of RSV. Knowledge deficits were substantial across multiple domains, with considerable proportions unable to identify transmission mechanisms, symptoms, or high-risk populations. The majority were unaware that preventive injections exist. Among those aware of RSV prevention, social media was the predominant information source, while healthcare professionals accounted for a small minority. Educational level showed a positive but non-significant association with RSV awareness. This study reveals critically low prevalence of RSV awareness among parents in Riyadh, with substantial knowledge gaps across all domains of RSV epidemiology and prevention. These findings underscore an urgent public health need for multi-level interventions targeting both community education and healthcare system strengthening. Integrating RSV education into maternal-child health services and developing culturally appropriate health communication strategies are essential to reduce the burden of RSV-related morbidity and mortality in Saudi Arabia.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2026 年 2 月至 3 月期间,对居住在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的父母进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查。通过在线平台进行便利抽样,招募了至少有一个孩子的父母。一份结构化、自我管理的阿拉伯语问卷评估了人口特征、既往 RSV 认知、传播 传播途径和临床表现的知识、高危人群的识别以及预防性免疫的认知。使用描述性统计和卡方检验对数据进行分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究显示,利雅得家长对 RSV 的认知度极低,只有 35.0%(95% CI:28.7-41.8%)以前听说过 RSV。多个领域的知识匮乏,相当大比例的人无法识别 传播 机制、症状或高危人群。大多数人不知道预防性注射的存在。在了解 RSV 预防的人群中,社交媒体是主要的信息来源,而医疗保健专业人员只占少数。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究发现 RSV 流行病学 和预防的所有领域都存在重大知识差距。教育水平与 RSV 认识呈正相关但不显着,这表明仅靠高等教育可能不足以提高 RSV 认识。该研究没有探讨获取医疗保健信息的潜在障碍或不同教育干预措施的有效性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现强调了公共卫生迫切需要针对社区教育和加强医疗保健系统的多层次干预措施。将 RSV 教育纳入母婴健康服务并制定适合文化的健康传播策略对于减轻沙特阿拉伯 RSV 相关发病率和 死亡率 的负担至关重要。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2026 年 2 月至 3 月期间,对居住在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的父母进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查。通过在线平台进行便利抽样,招募了至少有一个孩子的父母。一份结构化、自我管理的阿拉伯语问卷评估了人口特征、既往 RSV 认知、传播 传播途径和临床表现的知识、高危人群的识别以及预防性免疫的认知。使用描述性统计和卡方检验对数据进行分析。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究显示,利雅得家长对 RSV 的认知度极低,只有 35.0%(95% CI:28.7-41.8%)以前听说过 RSV。多个领域的知识匮乏,相当大比例的人无法识别 传播 机制、症状或高危人群。大多数人不知道预防性注射的存在。在了解 RSV 预防的人群中,社交媒体是主要的信息来源,而医疗保健专业人员只占少数。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究发现 RSV 流行病学 和预防的所有领域都存在重大知识差距。教育水平与 RSV 认识呈正相关但不显着,这表明仅靠高等教育可能不足以提高 RSV 认识。该研究没有探讨获取医疗保健信息的潜在障碍或不同教育干预措施的有效性。

papers.title: A multiplex dual-probe RT-LAMP assay for rapid subtype-specific detection of respiratory syncytial virus A and B.
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute respiratory tract infections, particularly in infants, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. RSV is classified into two major subtypes, RSV A and RSV B, which co-circulate seasonally and exhibit genetic variability, highlighting the need for rapid and subtype-specific diagnostic methods. Although reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) is the reference standard for RSV detection, its reliance on complex instrumentation limits its applicability in decentralized testing settings. In this study, we developed and evaluated a probe-based reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) assay for rapid detection and differentiation of RSV A and RSV B. The assay incorporates a dual-probe strategy, employing an assimilating probe for RSV A detection to ensure robust signal generation under multiplex conditions, and hybridization-based TaqMan-style probes (HyTaq probes) for RSV B detection and for an internal control targeting the human ACTB gene to ensure reaction validity. Analytical performance was assessed using serially diluted RSV positive clinical specimens and plasmid standards. Clinical performance was evaluated using 91 RSV A positive specimens, 97 RSV B positive specimens, and 120 RSV negative specimens, as defined by the reference diagnosis. The RSV A and RSV B RT-LAMP assays demonstrated sensitivities of 92.31% and 98.97%, respectively, with a specificity of 100% for both targets. No cross-reactivity was observed with a panel of common respiratory viruses. These results indicate that the proposed dual-probe RT-LAMP assay provides a rapid and specific approach for subtype-specific RSV detection, with potential applicability in decentralized diagnostic settings pending further validation.

papers.title_zh: 用于快速亚型特异性检测 呼吸道合胞病毒 A 和 B 的多重双探针 RT-LAMP 测定。
papers.source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute respiratory tract infections, particularly in infants, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. RSV is classified into two major subtypes, RSV A and RSV B, which co-circulate seasonally and exhibit genetic variability, highlighting the need for rapid and subtype-specific diagnostic methods. Although reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) is the reference standard for RSV detection, its reliance on complex instrumentation limits its applicability in decentralized testing settings. In this study, we developed and evaluated a probe-based reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) assay for rapid detection and differentiation of RSV A and RSV B. The assay incorporates a dual-probe strategy, employing an assimilating probe for RSV A detection to ensure robust signal generation under multiplex conditions, and hybridization-based TaqMan-style probes (HyTaq probes) for RSV B detection and for an internal control targeting the human ACTB gene to ensure reaction validity. Analytical performance was assessed using serially diluted RSV positive clinical specimens and plasmid standards. Clinical performance was evaluated using 91 RSV A positive specimens, 97 RSV B positive specimens, and 120 RSV negative specimens, as defined by the reference diagnosis. The RSV A and RSV B RT-LAMP assays demonstrated sensitivities of 92.31% and 98.97%, respectively, with a specificity of 100% for both targets. No cross-reactivity was observed with a panel of common respiratory viruses. These results indicate that the proposed dual-probe RT-LAMP assay provides a rapid and specific approach for subtype-specific RSV detection, with potential applicability in decentralized diagnostic settings pending further validation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study investigated the impact of public health measures on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission in Hong Kong, China, during the COVID-19 pandemic.

analysis.methods: The study assessed the association between specific public health measures, including mask wearing, avoidance behaviors, and hand hygiene, with RSV case reductions.

analysis.summary_en: This study examined the impact of public health measures on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission in Hong Kong, China, from 2020 to 2023. The findings showed that interventions such as mask wearing, avoidance behaviors, and hand hygiene were associated with reduced RSV cases, with mask wearing linked to a 35% reduction. After the mask mandate was lifted in March 2023, RSV activity resurged, suggesting the effectiveness of these measures in suppressing RSV spread. The study provides evidence for the utility of non-pharmaceutical interventions in controlling RSV transmission, with implications for future public health strategies.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2020 年至 2023 年中国香港的 RSV 活动,检验公共卫生干预措施的效果。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持使用公共卫生措施来减轻 RSV 传播,为未来的大流行防范和季节性 RSV 控制策略提供信息。

papers.title: Oleoyl-acyl carrier protein hydrolase promotes respiratory syncytial virus-mediated macrophage pyroptosis by inducing mitochondrial oxidative stress.
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of bronchitis and pneumonia in infants and the elderly, with alveolar macrophages playing a critical role in pathogenesis. Oleoyl-acyl carrier protein hydrolase (OLAH) exacerbates inflammation in macrophages; however, its specific function during RSV infection remains unclear. THP-1-derived macrophages were infected with RSV, and the expression levels of pyroptosis-related proteins, inflammatory factors, and macrophage apoptosis were detected using Western blotting, ELISA, qRT-PCR, and flow cytometry. Subsequently, OLAH-knockdown macrophages were treated with RSV to assess the impact of OLAH on RSV-induced pyroptosis and inflammatory responses. Additionally, intracellular oxidative stress levels were measured by Oil Red O staining, fluorescent probes, and kits for superoxide dismutase, malondialdehyde, and adenosine triphosphate, while mitochondrial membrane potential was evaluated using a JC-1 kit. Finally, an OLAH-overexpressing macrophage model was constructed and treated with a reactive oxygen species scavenger to investigate the underlying mechanism. RSV infection significantly upregulated pyroptosis-related proteins (GSDMD-FL, GSDMD-N), inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-18, NLRP3), the apoptosisrelated protein caspase-1, and chemokines (MIP-1α, MIP-1β). Increased macrophage apoptosis and elevated OLAH expression were also observed. OLAH knockdown alleviated RSV-induced pyroptosis, inflammation, and mitochondrial oxidative stress (MOS). This study demonstrates that OLAH facilitates RSV-mediated macrophage pyroptosis through the induction of MOS.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of Oleoyl-acyl carrier protein hydrolase (OLAH) in Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)-induced macrophage pyroptosis. OLAH knockdown alleviated RSV-induced pyroptosis, inflammation, and mitochondrial oxidative stress. The study demonstrates that OLAH facilitates RSV-mediated macrophage pyroptosis through the induction of mitochondrial oxidative stress, suggesting that targeting OLAH could be a potential therapeutic strategy for RSV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是婴儿和老年人支气管炎和肺炎的主要原因,肺泡巨噬细胞在 呼吸道合胞病毒 中发挥着关键作用。油酰基载体蛋白水解酶 (OLAH) 会加剧巨噬细胞的炎症;然而,其在RSV感染过程中的具体功能仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: RSV感染THP-1来源的巨噬细胞,采用Western blotting、ELISA、qRT-PCR和流式细胞术检测细胞焦亡相关蛋白、炎症因子和巨噬细胞凋亡的表达水平。
elements_zh.methods: 随后,用 RSV 处理 OLAH 敲低巨噬细胞,以评估 OLAH 对 RSV 诱导的细胞焦亡和炎症反应的影响。通过油红 O 染色、荧光探针和超氧化物歧化酶、丙二醛和三磷酸腺苷试剂盒测量细胞内氧化应激水平,同时使用 JC-1 试剂盒评估线粒体膜电位。最后,构建了 OLAH 过度表达的巨噬细胞模型,并用活性氧清除剂进行处理,以研究其潜在机制。
elements_zh.main_results: RSV感染显着上调焦亡相关蛋白(GSDMD-FL、GSDMD-N)、炎症细胞因子(IL-1β、IL-18、NLRP3)、凋亡相关蛋白caspase-1和趋化因子(MIP-1α、MIP-1β)。还观察到巨噬细胞凋亡增加和 OLAH 表达升高。OLAH 敲低可减轻 RSV 诱导的细胞焦亡、炎症和线粒体氧化应激 (MOS)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究表明,OLAH 通过诱导 MOS 促进 RSV 介导的巨噬细胞焦亡。这些发现为 RSV 发病机制 的分子机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,针对 OLAH 或线粒体氧化应激可能是 RSV 感染的潜在治疗策略。这种方法可能有助于减少巨噬细胞的炎症和细胞焦亡,从而可能改善高危人群的预后。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在体外使用 THP-1 衍生的巨噬细胞进行的,该巨噬细胞可能无法完全复制体内条件。由于实验模型范围有限且缺乏体内验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Prophylaxis: Maternal Vaccination or Long-Acting Monoclonal Antibodies? A Brief Narrative Review of Current Status
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a leading cause of severe lower respiratory tract infection in early infancy, with the highest burden concentrated in the first months of life. Two immunoprophylactic strategies—maternal RSVpreF vaccination and long-acting monoclonal antibodies—now offer effective early life protection, yet differ in biological mechanisms, operational requirements, and programmatic implications. Maternal vaccination induces high-quality neutralizing antibodies that are transferred transplacentally, providing immediate protection from birth and integrating efficiently into antenatal care platforms. However, its effectiveness is constrained by gestational timing, physiological antibody waning, and reduced protection when vaccination occurs shortly before delivery. Long-acting monoclonal antibodies, including nirsevimab and clesrovimab, bypass maternal immune variability and provide standardized, season-long protection across gestational ages, including preterm infants. Economic evaluations demonstrate that both strategies can be cost-effective, though their relative value depends on local epidemiology, pricing, and coverage patterns. Economic outcomes for monoclonal antibodies and maternal vaccination are highly context-dependent and influenced by regional RSV epidemiology, healthcare utilization, product pricing, and implementation capacity, rather than universally favoring one strategy over the other. Global equity considerations remain critical: disparities in antenatal care access, supply chain fragility, and pricing differentials may widen gaps between high- and low-income countries. Remaining evidence gaps—including long-term safety monitoring, durability of protection, viral evolution, and implementation challenges—underscore the need for continued research and careful integration of these tools into national immunization programs.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and its impact on early infancy, particularly in the first months of life. It evaluates two prophylactic strategies: maternal RSVpreF vaccination and long-acting monoclonal antibodies. Maternal vaccination is noted for its ability to transfer high-quality neutralizing antibodies transplacentally, offering immediate protection at birth and aligning well with antenatal care systems. However, its effectiveness is limited by gestational timing, antibody waning, and reduced protection when administered shortly before delivery. Long-acting monoclonal antibodies, such as nirsevimab and clesrovimab, provide standardized, season-long protection across gestational ages, including preterm infants, and bypass maternal immune variability. papers.title: [Significance of the multi-pathogen surveillance of pediatric patients with acute respiratory infections in Beijing from 2024 to 2025].
papers.abstract: Objective: To delineate the pathogen spectrum and epidemiological features of acute respiratory infections (ARI) among pediatric patients in Beijing during 2024-2025. Methods: In this cross-sectional study, 1 435 children diagnosed with ARI were enrolled from outpatient, emergency, respiratory medicine, and critical care medicine department of Capital Center for Children's Health, Capital Medical University between July 2024 and June 2025. Respiratory specimens were collected and screened for 28 respiratory pathogens using multiplex real-time quantitative PCR. Specimens positive for influenza virus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV), and human rhinovirus were further subtyped. Patients were categorized into influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) groups. Positivity rates across different sources, visit periods, and age groups were compared using the chi-square test and Wilcoxon rank-sum test. Results: Among the 1 435 children, there were 770 males and 665 females, with an age at presentation was 6.7 (4.4, 12.6) years. The total positive rate for the 28 pathogens was 80.5% (1 155/1 435). The ILI group comprised 1 040 cases (549 males, 491 females) with age at presentation was 6.8 (4.5, 12.8) years and the positive rate of 76.6% (797/1 040). Common viral pathogens included human rhinovirus 15.7% (163/1 040), human parainfluenza-virus (HPIV) 10.3% (107/1 040), and Influenza virus 7.1% (74/1 040), while common bacterial and atypical pathogens included Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) 18.7% (194/1 040), Haemophilus influenzae (HI) 18.4% (191/1 040), and Streptococcus pneumonia (SP) 17.1% (178/1 040). The SARI group comprised 395 cases (221 males, 174 females) with age at presentation was 6.5 (4.0, 12.3) years and the positive rate of 90.6% (358/395). Common viral pathogens included human rhinovirus 17.2% (68/395), RSV 9.9% (39/395), and HPIV 7.1% (28/395), while common bacterial and atypical pathogens included MP 51.4% (203/395), SP 15.4% (61/395), and HI 13.4% (53/395). Co-detections of multiple pathogens accounted for 43.0% (497/1 155) of all positive cases. The positivity rates of RSV and MP in the SARI group were significantly higher than those in the ILI group (both P<0.001). RSV positive rate was the highest in children under 1 year of age, accounting for 15.3% (13/85), while MP positive rate was the highest in children aged 7 to 18 years, accounting for 38.1% (205/538). Typing results revealed that 96.5% (83/86) were typed to H1N1 among influenza virus A cases, while 58.3% (42/72) were genotyped as RSV-A ON1 among RSV cases, 86.3% (63/73) were subtyped to B2 among HMPV cases, and 45.0% (104/231) were typed to human rhinovirus-A among human rhinovirus cases. Conclusion: The pathogen spectrum of pediatric patients with ARI in Beijing from 2024 to 2025 was characterized by the alternation or co-circulation of multiple bacteria and viruses, a high rate of co-detection of multiple pathogens, and different between SARI and ILI groups. Influenza virus was dominated by H1N1, RSV by RSV-A, HMPV by HMPV-B2, and human rhinovirus by human rhinovirus-A.

source_records.title: Respiratory infections
source_records.abstract: Abstract Pneumonia is diagnosed based on clinical symptoms and radiological features. It can be caused by a variety of pathogens including bacterial, mycobacterial, viral, fungal, and other atypical organisms. Most bacterial community-acquired pneumonia is due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is normally treated with penicillin and can be risk stratified using the CURB-65 score. Atypical organisms require macrolides. Hospital-acquired pneumonia involves Gram-negative or resistant organisms and treatment depends on local sensitivities. Viral pneumonias can include influenza and COVID-19, with antivirals used only in specific cases. Immunocompromised patients may develop invasive fungal infections such as Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia or invasive aspergillosis requiring targeted antifungals.

papers.title: Cost-utility of respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F (RSVpreF) maternal vaccine for disease prevention among colombian infants
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of acute lower respiratory tract infections in Colombia, therefore, as no widespread antiviral exists, maternal immunization using RSV prefusion F protein vaccine (RSVpreF) represents a promising strategy. This study aims to evaluate the cost-utility of the RSVpreF maternal vaccine in preventing RSV infections among Colombian infants. Methods We used a Markov model to simulate a Colombian birth cohort over a lifetime horizon, comparing maternal RSVpreF vaccination with no intervention, reflecting the current standard of care in Colombia. The model incorporated RSV-related outpatient visits, hospitalizations, and deaths. We collected data from clinical trials, peer-reviewed literature, and Colombian national health databases. Costs were analyzed from the perspective of the Colombian healthcare system, adjusted to 2024 USD, and we applied a 5% discount rate to both costs and outcomes. We used a willingness-to-pay (WTP) threshold of $ 7,491 per quality-adjusted life year (QALY). Sensitivity analyses, including one-way and probabilistic sensitivity analyses, were performed to evaluate the robustness of the results. Results Maternal RSVpreF vaccination was associated with a reduction of approximately 25,781 RSV-related cases and an increase of 2,315 QALYs. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was $ 2,322 per QALY, well below the WTP threshold. Sensitivity analyses identified vaccine effectiveness, vaccine cost and RSV hospitalization rates as the primary drivers of cost-effectiveness. The probabilistic sensitivity analysis indicated an 83.5% probability that the intervention would be cost-effective at the established WTP threshold. Conclusion Maternal RSVpreF vaccination is a cost-effective intervention in Colombia, resulting in significant reductions in RSV-related morbidity and mortality, as well as in the economic burden on the healthcare system. The findings support the inclusion of maternal RSV vaccination in national immunization programs, promoting health equity in underserved communities. Clinical trial number Not applicable.

papers.abstract_original: Abstract Background Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of acute lower respiratory tract infections in Colombia, therefore, as no widespread antiviral exists, maternal immunization using RSV prefusion F protein vaccine (RSVpreF) represents a promising strategy. This study aims to evaluate the cost-utility of the RSVpreF maternal vaccine in preventing RSV infections among Colombian infants. Methods We used a Markov model to simulate a Colombian birth cohort over a lifetime horizon, comparing maternal RSVpreF vaccination with no intervention, reflecting the current standard of care in Colombia. The model incorporated RSV-related outpatient visits, hospitalizations, and deaths. We collected data from clinical trials, peer-reviewed literature, and Colombian national health databases. Costs were analyzed from the perspective of the Colombian healthcare system, adjusted to 2024 USD, and we applied a 5% discount rate to both costs and outcomes. We used a willingness-to-pay (WTP) threshold of $ 7,491 per quality-adjusted life year (QALY). Sensitivity analyses, including one-way and probabilistic sensitivity analyses, were performed to evaluate the robustness of the results. Results Maternal RSVpreF vaccination was associated with a reduction of approximately 25,781 RSV-related cases and an increase of 2,315 QALYs. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was $ 2,322 per QALY, well below the WTP threshold. Sensitivity analyses identified vaccine effectiveness, vaccine cost and RSV hospitalization rates as the primary drivers of cost-effectiveness. The probabilistic sensitivity analysis indicated an 83.5% probability that the intervention would be cost-effective at the established WTP threshold. Conclusion Maternal RSVpreF vaccination is a cost-effective intervention in Colombia, resulting in significant reductions in RSV-related morbidity and mortality, as well as in the economic burden on the healthcare system. The findings support the inclusion of maternal RSV vaccination in national immunization programs, promoting health equity in underserved communities. Clinical trial number Not applicable.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是哥伦比亚急性下呼吸道感染的主要原因之一,因此,由于不存在广泛的 呼吸道合胞病毒,使用 RSV 预融合 F 蛋白 疫苗 (RSVpreF) 进行母体免疫是一种有前途的策略。本研究旨在评估 RSVpreF 孕产妇 疫苗 在预防哥伦比亚婴儿 RSV 感染方面的成本效益。方法 我们使用马尔可夫模型模拟哥伦比亚出生 队列研究 的一生,比较母亲 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 与无干预的情况,反映哥伦比亚当前的护理标准。该模型纳入了与 RSV 相关的门诊就诊、住院和死亡情况。我们从临床试验、同行评审文献和哥伦比亚国家健康数据库中收集了数据。从哥伦比亚医疗保健系统的角度分析成本,调整为 2024 美元,并对成本和结果应用 5% 的折扣率。我们使用的支付意愿 (WTP) 门槛为每个质量调整生命年 (QALY) 7,491 美元。进行敏感性分析,包括单向敏感性分析和概率敏感性分析,以评估结果的稳健性。结果 母亲 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 与 RSV 相关病例减少约 25,781 例以及 QALY 增加 2,315 例相关。增量成本效益比 (ICER) 为每 QALY 2,322 美元,远低于 WTP 阈值。敏感性分析确定 疫苗 有效性、疫苗 成本和 RSV 住院率是成本效益的主要驱动因素。概率敏感性分析表明,在既定的 WTP 阈值下,干预措施具有成本效益的概率为 83.5%。结论 在哥伦比亚,孕产妇 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 是一种具有成本效益的干预措施,可显着降低 RSV 相关发病率和 死亡率,并减轻医疗保健系统的经济负担。研究结果支持将孕产妇 RSV 疫苗接种 纳入国家免疫规划,促进服务欠缺社区的健康公平。临床试验编号 不适用。

papers.title: Post-Pandemic Resurgence of Respiratory Syncytial Virus in Thailand: Molecular Epidemiology and Sublineage Turnover Among Children, 2023-2025.
papers.abstract: Non-pharmaceutical interventions implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic profoundly disrupted the established seasonality of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) worldwide. However, molecular epidemiological data on RSV resurgence and genetic diversity in tropical regions during the post-pandemic period remain scarce. This study investigated the molecular epidemiology, seasonal trends, genetic diversity, and evolutionary dynamics of RSV circulating among Thai children with respiratory illness between 2023 and 2025. Of 5198 respiratory specimens, 697 (13.4%) tested positive for RSV, with a pronounced post-pandemic resurgence observed in 2023 (18.3%). RSV seasonality returned to its typical pre-pandemic pattern, peaking during the rainy season (July-November). A shift in age distribution was observed, with the highest burden occurring among 3-year-olds (27.0%). Alternating subgroup dominance was evident, with RSV-B predominating in 2023 (44.4%) and 2025 (43.9%), while RSV-A predominated in 2024 (46.3%). All RSV-A strains belonged to the ON1 genotype (A.D lineage), exhibiting sequential annual turnover of dominant sublineages from A.D.5.2 to A.D.1.4 and A.D.3. Conversely, RSV-B strains belonged to the BA9 genotype (B.D lineage) with sustained dominance of the B.D.E.1 sublineage (76.7%). Distinct lineage-specific amino acid substitutions suggested ongoing viral diversification and immune selection pressures. These findings underscore the importance of continued molecular surveillance to inform RSV prevention strategies.

papers.title: Screening and mechanism analysis of core target genes for resveratrol inhibiting respiratory syncytial virus.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), a single-stranded negative-sense RNA virus, is a major pathogen of acute respiratory tract infections, posing severe threats to the health of infants, the elderly and immunocompromised individuals. While approved vaccines for older adults and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis for infants are available, effective therapeutic drugs remain scarce. Resveratrol, a phenolic compound naturally present in grapes, berries and other foods, has been confirmed to exhibit anti-RSV activity, but its molecular mechanism of action remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to screen the core targets and key signaling pathways of resveratrol against RSV using computational biology approaches, propose testable research hypotheses and provide a theoretical basis for subsequent experimental validation. METHODS: A total of 261 resveratrol-related targets and 1196 RSV-related targets were retrieved from databases. Venny 2.1.0 was used to identify 67 overlapping targets, which were then subjected to protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction via STRING/Cytoscape and topological analysis for core target screening. GO/KEGG enrichment analyses were performed using the DAVID database and molecular docking validation was conducted with PyMOL/AutoDock. RESULTS: Ten core targets including EGFR, SRC, HSP90AA1 and ALB were identified. GO enrichment focused on biological processes such as PI3K-Akt signal transduction and MAPK cascade regulation, while KEGG pathways were enriched in the Ras signaling pathway and others. Molecular docking showed stable binding of resveratrol to core targets, with all binding energies <-5 kcal/mol. CONCLUSION: This in-silico study predicts that resveratrol may exert anti-RSV effects by targeting host proteins such as EGFR and SRC and regulating key pathways including PI3K-Akt and Ras, complementing existing evidence of its direct interaction with viral proteins. The study provides novel insights for anti-RSV drug development and a theoretical foundation for subsequent experimental validation.

papers.title: Respiratory syncytial virus under 2 years of age: hospitalization trends and risk factors for severe disease Ó? preliminary data from the Portuguese sentinel network
papers.abstract: Introduction and Objectives: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection is an important cause of hospitalization in children under five years. A national RSV sentinel network was set up in Portugal in April 2021. We describe the trends in RSV hospitalizations until September 2022 and identify risk factors for severe disease. Methods: Acute respiratory infections in hospitalized children under two years were reported and tested for RSV. RSV disease severity was defined by the need for ventilation or admission to an intensive care unit. Risk ratios were used to assess the association between gender, age group, gestational age, birthweight, chronic conditions, RSV subtype and severity of disease. Results: We detected two RSV off-season epidemics in June 2021 to February 2022 and May to September 2022. 63.3% of RSV-related hospitalizations occurred in children under six months old and 8.0% had chronic conditions. 11.0% had severe disease. Children under six months and with chronic conditions had, respectively, an 18-fold risk and a 2-fold risk of developing severe illness. Discussion: The off-season RSV epidemics were probably triggered by the relaxation of COVID-19 physical distancing measures and immunity debt. In the first epidemic, the proportion of children with severe disease was higher than reported by previous studies, however, this result is probably overestimated due to the high proportion of cases notified by central hospitals. Age < 6 months and chronic conditions predispose to severe disease. As several factors may change the pattern of RSV activity, causing more severe outbreaks at different times, countries should implement year-round RSV surveillance systems.

papers.title: Screening of key host targets and mechanistic assessment of berberine modulation of host responses to respiratory syncytial virus.
papers.abstract: ObjectiveTo screen potential host targets and investigate the molecular mechanism by which berberine regulates host responses to respiratory syncytial virus infection.MethodsThe structure and potential targets of berberine were retrieved and predicted using the PubChem, Swiss Target Prediction, and Pharm Mapper databases. Respiratory syncytial virus-related targets were screened from the GeneCards and Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man databases. Intersection targets were obtained using Venny 2.1.0. A protein-protein interaction network of the intersection targets was constructed using the Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins, and core targets were screened by performing topological analysis using Cytoscape. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses were performed using the Database for Annotation, Visualization and Integrated Discovery. Molecular docking between berberine and the core targets was conducted using PyMol and AutoDock.ResultsIn total, 299 berberine targets and 1196 respiratory syncytial virus targets were obtained, with 72 intersecting targets. Protein-protein interaction analysis identified 6 core targets, including epidermal growth factor receptor, Src, heat shock protein 90-alpha, albumin, signal transducer and activator of transcription 1, and caspase-3. Gene Ontology enrichment analysis indicated that the intersecting targets were involved in biological processes such as the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signaling pathway, localized in cellular components including cytosol, and possessed molecular functions such as protein kinase activity. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analysis enriched 145 signaling pathways. Molecular docking results showed that the binding energies of berberine to the 8 core targets were all lower than -5 kcal/mol, presenting strong binding affinity.ConclusionThrough network pharmacology and molecular docking, this study preliminarily suggests that berberine targets epidermal growth factor receptor, Src, heat shock protein 90-alpha, albumin, signal transducer and activator of transcription 1, and caspase-3 and regulates cell proliferation, inflammatory response, antiviral immunity, and cell apoptosis to modulate host response to respiratory syncytial virus infection. This study represents a purely bioinformatics prediction research, and its findings potentially provide a preliminary theoretical basis for elucidating the mechanism by which berberine regulates respiratory syncytial virus infection.

papers.title_zh: 筛选关键 宿主 靶标并评估小檗碱对 宿主 对 宿主 反应的调节作用。
papers.source_body_en: ObjectiveTo screen potential host targets and investigate the molecular mechanism by which berberine regulates host responses to respiratory syncytial virus infection.MethodsThe structure and potential targets of berberine were retrieved and predicted using the PubChem, Swiss Target Prediction, and Pharm Mapper databases. Respiratory syncytial virus-related targets were screened from the GeneCards and Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man databases. Intersection targets were obtained using Venny 2.1.0. A protein-protein interaction network of the intersection targets was constructed using the Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins, and core targets were screened by performing topological analysis using Cytoscape. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses were performed using the Database for Annotation, Visualization and Integrated Discovery. Molecular docking between berberine and the core targets was conducted using PyMol and AutoDock.ResultsIn total, 299 berberine targets and 1196 respiratory syncytial virus targets were obtained, with 72 intersecting targets. Protein-protein interaction analysis identified 6 core targets, including epidermal growth factor receptor, Src, heat shock protein 90-alpha, albumin, signal transducer and activator of transcription 1, and caspase-3. Gene Ontology enrichment analysis indicated that the intersecting targets were involved in biological processes such as the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signaling pathway, localized in cellular components including cytosol, and possessed molecular functions such as protein kinase activity. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analysis enriched 145 signaling pathways. Molecular docking results showed that the binding energies of berberine to the 8 core targets were all lower than -5 kcal/mol, presenting strong binding affinity.ConclusionThrough network pharmacology and molecular docking, this study preliminarily suggests that berberine targets epidermal growth factor receptor, Src, heat shock protein 90-alpha, albumin, signal transducer and activator of transcription 1, and caspase-3 and regulates cell proliferation, inflammatory response, antiviral immunity, and cell apoptosis to modulate host response to respiratory syncytial virus infection. This study represents a purely bioinformatics prediction research, and its findings potentially provide a preliminary theoretical basis for elucidating the mechanism by which berberine regulates respiratory syncytial virus infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的筛选宿主潜在靶点,探讨小檗碱调节宿主感染宿主反应的分子机制。方法利用PubChem、Swiss Target Prediction和Pharm Mapper数据库检索和预测小檗碱的结构和潜在靶点。从 GeneCards 和 Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man 数据库中筛选出 呼吸道合胞病毒 相关靶标。交叉口目标是使用 Venny 2.1.0 获得的。使用用于检索相互作用基因/蛋白质的搜索工具构建交叉靶标的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络,并使用Cytoscape进行拓扑分析来筛选核心靶标。使用注释、可视化和集成发现数据库进行基因本体论和京都基因百科全书以及 基因组 富集分析。利用PyMol和AutoDock对小檗碱与核心靶点进行分子对接。结果总共获得了299个小檗碱靶点和1196个呼吸道合胞病毒靶点,其中交叉靶点72个。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析确定了6个核心靶标,包括表皮生长因子受体、Src、热休克蛋白90-α、白蛋白、信号转导子和转录激活子1以及caspase-3。Gene Ontology富集分析表明,交叉靶标参与磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B信号通路等生物过程,定位于细胞质等细胞成分,并具有蛋白激酶活性等分子功能。京都基因百科全书和基因组分析丰富了145条信号通路。分子对接结果显示,小檗碱与8个核心靶点的结合能均低于-5 kcal/mol,具有较强的结合亲和力。结论通过网络药理学和分子对接,本研究初步提示小檗碱靶向表皮生长因子受体、Src、热休克蛋白90-α、白蛋白、信号转导和转录激活子1、caspase-3,调节细胞增殖、炎症反应、 抗病毒药物 免疫和细胞凋亡调节 宿主 对 呼吸道合胞病毒 感染的反应。本研究是一项纯粹的生物信息学预测研究,其研究结果可能为阐明小檗碱调节呼吸道合胞病毒感染的机制提供初步的理论基础。

papers.title: Insights Into monoclonal antibodies and vaccines targeting respiratory viruses
papers.abstract: Introduction Viral respiratory infections are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in children worldwide, with lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) a major contributor to hospitalizations and healthcare utilization. Among respiratory pathogens, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of severe disease in early life and has driven major advances in preventive strategies. Increasing evidence also suggests that early-life viral infections may influence long-term respiratory outcomes, including recurrent wheezing and asthma. Aim of the study This article provides a comprehensive overview of the epidemiological burden, risk factors, and long-term consequences of pediatric viral infections. It also examines RSV as a case study in the evolution of preventive strategies and explores knowledge that can be translated from RSV management to other major respiratory viruses, including influenza, SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, human metapneumovirus (HMPV), and parainfluenza. Discussion RSV has reshaped pediatric respiratory prevention through the development of monoclonal antibodies and maternal vaccination strategies, enabling a shift from high-risk-based approaches to broader population-level protection. Advances in structural virology have enabled targeting of conserved viral epitopes, thereby improving efficacy and the duration of protection. Similar strategies are being explored for other respiratory viruses. However, antigenic variability, limited pediatric data, and incomplete vaccine effectiveness remain significant barriers. Conclusion RSV experience provides a robust foundation for preventing viral respiratory infections. Integrating passive and active immunization strategies, targeting conserved viral structures, and improving global access are essential to reduce the disease burden of pediatric respiratory infections.

However, antigenic variability, limited pediatric data, and incomplete vaccine effectiveness remain challenges. Integrating immunization strategies and improving global access are key to reducing disease burden.

papers.source_body_en: Introduction Viral respiratory infections are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in children worldwide, with lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) a major contributor to hospitalizations and healthcare utilization. Among respiratory pathogens, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of severe disease in early life and has driven major advances in preventive strategies. Increasing evidence also suggests that early-life viral infections may influence long-term respiratory outcomes, including recurrent wheezing and asthma. Aim of the study This article provides a comprehensive overview of the epidemiological burden, risk factors, and long-term consequences of pediatric viral infections. It also examines RSV as a case study in the evolution of preventive strategies and explores knowledge that can be translated from RSV management to other major respiratory viruses, including influenza, SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, human metapneumovirus (HMPV), and parainfluenza. Discussion RSV has reshaped pediatric respiratory prevention through the development of monoclonal antibodies and maternal vaccination strategies, enabling a shift from high-risk-based approaches to broader population-level protection. Advances in structural virology have enabled targeting of conserved viral epitopes, thereby improving efficacy and the duration of protection. Similar strategies are being explored for other respiratory viruses. However, antigenic variability, limited pediatric data, and incomplete vaccine effectiveness remain significant barriers. Conclusion RSV experience provides a robust foundation for preventing viral respiratory infections. Integrating passive and active immunization strategies, targeting conserved viral structures, and improving global access are essential to reduce the disease burden of pediatric respiratory infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言 病毒性呼吸道感染是全球儿童发病率和死亡率的主要原因,其中下呼吸道感染(LRTIs)是导致住院和医疗利用的主要因素。在呼吸道病原体中,呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是导致生命早期严重疾病的主要原因,并推动了预防策略的重大进展。越来越多的证据也表明,生命早期的病毒感染可能影响长期呼吸道结局,包括复发性喘息和哮喘。研究目的 本文全面概述了儿童病毒感染的流行病学负担、风险因素和长期后果。它还以进化为例研究了预防策略的发展,并探讨了可以从RSV管理中转化为其他主要呼吸道病毒的知识,包括流感、SARS-CoV-2、鼻病毒、人类偏肺病毒(HMPV)和副流感病毒。讨论 RSV通过开发单克隆抗体和母体疫苗接种策略,改变了儿科呼吸道预防,使预防方法从高风险人群转向更广泛的人群保护。结构病毒学的进展使得能够靶向保守的病毒表位,从而提高保护效果和持续时间。类似策略正在探索用于其他呼吸道病毒。然而,抗原变异性、有限的儿科数据和不完整的疫苗有效性仍然是重大障碍。结论 RSV的经验为预防病毒性呼吸道感染提供了坚实的基础。整合被动和主动免疫策略、靶向保守的病毒结构以及改善全球获取途径对于减少儿童呼吸道感染的疾病负担至关重要。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of a maternal RSV prefusion F protein vaccine to prevent RSV infection in infants.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a corrected clinical trial conducted in multiple centers, involving pregnant women and their infants, with the study period spanning from 2023 to 2024.
analysis.methods: The vaccine was administered to pregnant women during the third trimester, and its efficacy was assessed by comparing the incidence of RSV infection in infants of vaccinated mothers versus unvaccinated mothers.
analysis.main_results: The corrected analysis showed vaccine efficacy of 4.1% (95% CI, −9.5 to 16.0) against all-cause medically attended lower respiratory tract illness within 180 days postpartum.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors note that the corrected efficacy estimate provides a more accurate understanding of the vaccine's effectiveness over a longer period, highlighting the importance of precise timeframes in vaccine trials.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings contribute to the development of maternal vaccines for RSV, potentially informing future strategies for preventing RSV-related illnesses in infants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported outcomes and the small sample size, which may affect the strength of the evidence. However, the correction enhances the reliability of the reported efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of a maternal RSV prefusion F protein vaccine. The corrected analysis reports vaccine efficacy of 4.1% (95% CI, −9.5 to 16.0) against all-cause medically attended lower respiratory tract illness within 180 days postpartum. The trial involved pregnant women and their infants across multiple centers, with the vaccine administered during the third trimester. The authors emphasize the importance of accurate timeframes in vaccine trials, noting that the corrected efficacy estimate provides a more reliable assessment. The findings may inform future strategies for preventing RSV-related illnesses in infants. However, the study's reliance on self-reported outcomes and small sample size limits the confidence in the results. The evidence is considered moderate due to these limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估母体 RSV 预融合 F 蛋白 疫苗 预防婴儿 RSV 感染的有效性、安全性和免疫原性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项在多个中心进行的校正临床试验,涉及孕妇及其婴儿,研究期跨越2023年至2024年。
elements_zh.methods: 疫苗 在妊娠晚期对孕妇进行注射,并通过比较接种疫苗的母亲与未接种疫苗的母亲所生婴儿的 RSV 感染 发病率 来评估其疗效。
elements_zh.main_results: 校正后的分析显示,疫苗 对产后 180 天内全因医疗下呼吸道疾病的疗效为 4.1%(95% CI,-9.5 至 16.0)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者指出,修正后的疗效估计可以更准确地了解 疫苗 在较长时间内的有效性,强调了 疫苗 试验中精确时间范围的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于针对 RSV 的母体 疫苗 的开发,可能为未来预防婴儿 RSV 相关疾病的策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对自我报告结果的依赖和样本量较小而受到限制,这可能会影响证据的强度。然而,修正提高了报告功效的可靠性。

papers.title: Seasonality of influenza virus, respiratory syncytial virus, rhinovirus and metapneumovirus in patients managed at a tertiary care hospital in Martinique (French Caribbean Island), 2016–2021
papers.abstract: Respiratory viruses show marked geographical variability in their temporal circulation, particularly in tropical settings where epidemiological data remain limited. Understanding local circulation patterns is essential to contextualize respiratory virus epidemiology outside temperate regions. We conducted a monocentric, hospital-based observational study including patients presenting with acute febrile respiratory syndromes at the University Hospital of Martinique between January 2016 and July 2021. Respiratory samples were tested by RT-PCR for influenza virus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), rhinovirus (RhV), and human metapneumovirus (hMPV). Viral circulation periods were defined as consecutive weeks with at least one positive detection. A total of 7,316 patients were included, of whom 86.2% were hospitalized. Influenza virus and RSV showed clear epidemic patterns, whereas RhV and hMPV circulated throughout the year. Influenza virus circulation generally occurred from November/December to April/May (mean duration 14.6 ± 3.0 weeks), while RSV circulation started earlier, from August/September to February/March (20.0 ± 2.9 weeks). Rhinovirus circulated year-round with reduced activity during mid-summer. The emergence of SARS-CoV-2 in 2020 was associated with major disruptions in the circulation of influenza virus and RSV, while RhV circulation rapidly resumed. This retrospective hospital-based study identified distinct temporal patterns of viral detection among patients managed at a tertiary referral hospital in Martinique. These findings provide context-specific data on respiratory virus epidemiology in a tropical Caribbean island and may contribute to discussions on the timing of locally adapted preventive strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the seasonality of respiratory viruses, including RSV, in Martinique from 2016 to 2021. The monocentric hospital-based observational study included 7,316 patients with acute febrile respiratory syndromes, tested by RT-PCR for influenza virus, RSV, rhinovirus, and human metapneumovirus. RSV showed a clear epidemic pattern circulating from August/September to February/March (20.0 ± 2.9 weeks), while rhinovirus circulated year-round. The emergence of SARS-CoV-2 in 2020 disrupted influenza and RSV circulation. The findings provide context-specific data for tropical regions and may inform locally adapted preventive strategies, though the single-center design limits generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道病毒的时间传播表现出明显的地理变异性,特别是在流行病学数据仍然有限的热带地区。了解局部循环模式对于了解温带地区以外的呼吸道病毒 流行病学 的情况至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们进行了一项单中心、以医院为基础的观察性研究,纳入了 2016 年 1 月至 2021 年 7 月期间在马提尼克大学医院出现急性发热呼吸综合征的患者。总共纳入了 7,316 名患者,其中 86.2% 住院治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 RT-PCR 检测呼吸道样本中的流感病毒、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV)、鼻病毒 (RhV) 和人偏肺病毒 (hMPV)。病毒传播期定义为至少有一次阳性检测的连续几周。
elements_zh.main_results: 流感病毒和RSV表现出明显的流行模式,而RhV和hMPV全年都有传播。RSV 循环开始较早,从 8 月/9 月到 2 月/3 月(20.0 ± 2.9 周)。2020 年 SARS-CoV-2 的出现与流感病毒和 RSV 循环的严重破坏有关,而 RhV 循环则迅速恢复。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项基于医院的回顾性研究确定了马提尼克岛一家三级转诊医院管理的患者中病毒检测的不同时间模式。这些发现提供了热带加勒比岛屿呼吸道病毒 流行病学 的具体情况数据,可能有助于讨论当地适应的预防策略的时机。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能会为热带地区针对呼吸道病毒采取适合当地情况的预防策略的时机提供信息。这些数据有助于了解先前信息有限的地区 RSV 和其他呼吸道病毒的 流行病学。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在一家三级护理医院进行的,这可能限制了对其他环境或人群的推广。由于样本量大和系统测试,证据强度中等,但单中心设计和回顾性引入了潜在的局限性。

papers.title: Infant Infection With Respiratory Syncytial Virus Genotypes and Subsequent Childhood Asthma Risk.
papers.abstract: Our objective was to test the hypothesis that respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection during infancy with genotypes containing previously reported G gene sequence duplications (Gdups) is associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma. In a population-based, prospective, birth cohort of healthy, term children, we found that children with RSV-A Gdup+ (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 2.00, 95%CI = 1.15-3.47) and RSV-B Gdup + (aOR = 1.78, 95%CI = 1.01-3.11) infections during infancy had higher odds of 5-year current asthma than those without RSV infection during infancy. These findings are proof-of-concept evidence that RSV genetic variation is associated with variable childhood asthma risk.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A population-based, prospective, birth cohort study of healthy, term children was conducted to assess the association between RSV infection and childhood asthma risk.
analysis.methods: The study involved analyzing RSV infections in a birth cohort of healthy, term children, with specific attention to genotypes containing G gene sequence duplications (Gdups) and their association with asthma outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Children with RSV-A Gdup+ infections had an adjusted odds ratio of 2.00 (95%CI = 1.15-3.47) for 5-year current asthma compared to those without RSV infection, while RSV-B Gdup+ infections had an adjusted odds ratio of 1.78 (95%CI = 1.01-3.11).

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform future surveillance and research efforts on RSV genetic variation and its potential role in childhood asthma development.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between RSV infection during infancy with G gene sequence duplications (Gdups) and the risk of childhood asthma. elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为未来的 监测 和 RSV 遗传变异及其在儿童哮喘发展中的潜在作用的研究工作提供信息。

papers.title: An evaluation of the anti-human respiratory syncytial virus activity of sophora alkaloids and the enhanced efficacy by liposomes via intratracheal administration
papers.abstract: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs. Sophora alkaloids, natural compounds derived from Sophora flavescens, exhibit broad-spectrum antiviral and immunomodulatory activities. Mechanistically, RSV relies on ERK1/2 phosphorylation to facilitate viral replication and spread, while sophora alkaloids inhibit ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulating MEK/ERK signaling pathway, thereby suppressing viral proliferation and the inflammatory response caused by RSV infection. In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. To further enhance the pulmonary retention of drugs, liposomes were used to improve the therapeutic effects of sophora alkaloids. As the most effective sophora alkaloids against RSV infection, sophocarpine (SC) was encapsulated in liposomes to enhance its anti-RSV infection effect. In vivo studies demonstrate that SC-loaded liposomes outperformed the free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models of RSV infection. This study not only clarifies the mechanism by which sophora alkaloids counteract RSV-infection but also provides liposomal formulation of SC to improve the anti-RSV therapeutic effects.

The findings suggest potential for developing novel antiviral treatments for RSV, particularly for severe respiratory infections. However, the study is limited to in vivo experiments, which may affect the generalizability of results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of broader validation and the focus on a single model system.

papers.abstract_zh: 人类 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是婴儿、幼儿和老年人严重下呼吸道感染和相关死亡的主要原因。由于 RSV 的高 突变 发生率以及现有 抗病毒药物 药物的疗效和安全性有限,RSV 的临床管理具有挑战性。苦参生物碱是从苦参中提取的天然化合物,具有广谱 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节活性。从机制上讲,RSV依赖ERK1/2磷酸化来促进病毒复制和传播,而槐花生物碱通过调节MEK/ERK信号通路抑制ERK1/2磷酸化,从而抑制病毒增殖和RSV感染引起的炎症反应。体内研究表明,槐花生物碱通过气管内给药可显着降低 RSV 感染小鼠的 死亡率。为了进一步增强药物的肺滞留,采用脂质体来提高苦参生物碱的治疗效果。槐果碱(SC)作为抗RSV感染最有效的生物碱,将其封装在脂质体中以增强其抗RSV感染的效果。体内研究表明,在 RSV 感染的小鼠模型中,负载 SC 的脂质体在抑制 RSV 复制和减轻肺部炎症方面优于游离 SC。本研究不仅阐明了槐花生物碱抗RSV感染的机制,而且提供了SC的脂质体制剂,以提高抗RSV的治疗效果。
